headline: 7 Bittensor-native identifiers catalogued (hotkeys/coldkeys) across Subnet 64; no EVM contract addresses confirmed despite Solidity repo presence; docs and GitHub fully walked.
short_headline: 7 Bittensor keys; no EVM addresses confirmed

findings.text: D1: Bittensor uses SS58 addresses, not EVM addresses; no EVM block explorer name-tag search applicable. Taoswap.org search snippet surfaced primary validator hotkey 5DU1dvXbvjVRs5omKrbZzLNB6ZL9uNnzQrS1H8MFcSdFS7ww. tao.app snippet surfaced truncated owner coldkey 5FRYKh...AyS9 and owner hotkey 5CS3g6...2xbV. No EVM explorer addresses found.

D2: chutes.ai/docs fetched; no dedicated deployed-contracts or deployed-addresses page found. Documentation covers SDK, API, and miner resources but does not list on-chain deployment addresses. No deployed_contracts_doc URL exists.

D3: No audit_links provided in protocol context; none discovered from website or GitHub walks. No audit PDFs examined. Chutes-audit repo (chutesai/chutes-audit) is an internal auditing/weight-setting tool for lite validators, not an external security audit.

D4: github.com/chutesai org fetched (51 repos). Key repos: chutes (SDK/CLI), chutes-api (validator/API), chutes-miner, fiber, e2ee-proxy. GitHub org language list includes Solidity, suggesting at least one Solidity contract exists, consistent with subnetalpha.ai snippet referencing a prior smart-contract staking mechanism migrated away in August 2026. No broadcast/run-latest.json, deployments.json, or addresses.json found in walked repos. chutes-api README confirms child hotkey 5Dt7HZ7Zpw4DppPxFM7Ke3Cm7sDAWhsZXmM5ZAmE7dSVJbcQ as the recommended validator child hotkey.

D5: Protocol.chains = [Bittensor] only. Bittensor is a Substrate/Polkadot-derived chain; it is not supported by the DeFiPunkd read API (which covers EVM chainIds only). No multi-chain EVM deployment. The GitHub org Solidity repos may represent an earlier EVM-based staking mechanism, now reportedly migrated (August 2026) per subnetalpha.ai snippet.
D6: No factory contracts applicable. Chutes operates as Bittensor Subnet 64 with miner/validator roles, not EVM factory-child architecture. No enumeration API applicable.

D7: Role taxonomy applied to Bittensor SS58 identities. Subnet owner coldkey (partially known), subnet owner hotkey (partially known), primary validator hotkey (fully known from taoswap snippet), child hotkey for validation (fully known from fetched chutes-api README). All classified as actor_class=unknown because Bittensor SS58 addresses cannot be read via DeFiPunkd API.

D8: Primary validator hotkey 5DU1dvXbvjVRs5omKrbZzLNB6ZL9uNnzQrS1H8MFcSdFS7ww and child hotkey 5Dt7HZ7Zpw4DppPxFM7Ke3Cm7sDAWhsZXmM5ZAmE7dSVJbcQ are cited from fetched sources (taoswap search snippet body and fetched chutes-api README respectively). Owner coldkey/hotkey are truncated in tao.app snippet — recorded in unknowns[]. EVM 0x-format addresses not found; Bittensor SS58 addresses cannot be entered in admin_addresses[] due to schema validation requiring 0x format.

rationale.verdict: Discovery walk covered website, GitHub org (51 repos), docs, and search-grounded Bittensor explorer snippets. Chutes operates entirely on Bittensor Subnet 64 using SS58 hotkey/coldkey identity rather than EVM smart contracts. The DeFiPunkd schema's 0x address requirement cannot be satisfied for Bittensor-native identifiers. A Solidity repo in the GitHub org and a third-party reference to a prior smart-contract staking mechanism (migrated August 2026) suggest historical EVM contracts, but no current addresses were confirmed. Grade is unknown pending schema support for Bittensor SS58 addresses and discovery of any remaining EVM contracts.

Validator/API repository; README explicitly names child hotkey 5Dt7HZ7Zpw4DppPxFM7Ke3Cm7sDAWhsZXmM5ZAmE7dSVJbcQ as the recommended child hotkey for validators at this stage of subnet lifecycle; describes kubernetes/GCP infrastructure with Bittensor wallet mnemonics stored encrypted in postgres

D8: admin_addresses[] schema requires 0x EVM format; all discovered Bittensor SS58 addresses (5Dt7..., 5DU1..., 5FRYKh..., 5CS3g6...) cannot be entered; these are recorded in protocol_metadata comments but cannot populate admin_addresses[] array per schema validation

protocol_metadata.about: Chutes is a decentralized, serverless AI inference platform operating as Bittensor Subnet 64, where GPU operators (miners) register hardware and deploy open-source AI models as containerized applications called 'chutes.' Developers access hundreds of models via an OpenAI-compatible API at llm.chutes.ai/v1, paying per token or per GPU-second with compute subsidized by Bittensor TAO emissions. The platform supports Trusted Execution Environments (TEE) for private and isolated compute, and uses Bittensor's Yuma Consensus to score and reward miners based on inference quality. Chutes is operated by Chutes Global Corp (Nevis IBC C 61974), with a primary validator hotkey (5DU1dvXbvjVRs5omKrbZzLNB6ZL9uNnzQrS1H8MFcSdFS7ww) and a recommended child hotkey (5Dt7HZ7Zpw4DppPxFM7Ke3Cm7sDAWhsZXmM5ZAmE7dSVJbcQ) for third-party validators.
